title: Estrangement Between Banda Singh And Tat Khalsa

blocks.text: The Khalsa rebukes Banda for miracle-claims, Lahore dreams, and spiritual deviation, and explicitly rejects the Baisno panth he has begun to cultivate.
Even death in battle is preferable, they say, to abandoning the Guru’s discipline for a softened or distorted order.
Baisno panth is the clearest anchor here because it names the doctrinal form of Banda’s separation in the poet’s telling.
